code_locations.fact: No explicit port; traci.start called at line 114. All exceptions clear env._connection and are wrapped.
getFreeSocketPort binds an ephemeral IPv4 socket with SO_REUSEADDR, obtains port, closes socket, returns port; reservation is released before SUMO bind.
Port selection precedes Popen and init; automatic retry catches TraCIException only, not struct.error.
getVersion response parsing needs a 3-byte command prefix; malformed/short packet raises struct.error.
Connection is registered before getVersion succeeds; its process field is the locally launched process, not authenticated peer identity.
A completed job is reused only when summary/job identity/steps/model SHA pass; incomplete attempts cause a new fresh attempt.

evidence.note: Shared parallel stderr is interleaved. Adjacent address-in-use line is not PID/port tagged, so exact worker association is not conclusively established.

inference.note: The traceback is in SUMO startup during reset, not reward calculation or a neural-network update. It does not establish why the received packet was short.
inference.certainty: Plausible, not proven; selected port, failed SUMO PID, and peer identity were not logged.
inference.likely_explanation: Unreserved ephemeral port selection and concurrent SUMO launches create a port-reuse/launch race consistent with the adjacent address-in-use message and failed initial handshake.
